description.zh: Firefly 采用纯正的 IPLC 国际专线架构，配合 VLESS 现代协议，即使在特殊敏感时期也能保障极高的可用度。官网提供免翻墙直连通道，方便新用户续费与管理。
description.en: Firefly Network is a high-performance cross-border proxy provider. Featuring Pure IPLC / VLESS / Residential IP, Gigabit Dedicated IPLC, and full support for Netflix, 4K YouTube streaming, and AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude. Starting at ¥25/月.
